what: Inside the panel (parent) where the button sits, the button follows the cursor late with 1s expo.out — it moves by the distance from the panel center to the cursor, and when the cursor leaves the panel it returns to the center on the same curve. This keeps the Play button over a video always under the cursor.

from.where: index.html .hero__play (yellow play button over the video)

note: The original is anime.js createAnimatable(x·y, outExpo, 1000ms). On touch devices and with reduced motion it stays still in the center
